Wolf Companion : ???
Pulling Strings : ???
Night Moves : ???

Am I right ?

François Alix, from France

This is indeed true. I have some of them, but not all. I personally
decided that it wasn't worth thrying to complete a set, with the
multiple
differences (some of my friends did) as it was proving costly with
the rares at the time.

following

Renegade Garou : Title written Renegade or Renagade

Hope this is of some help. Let me know if you need to find any, and I'll
look through what I have. (I know we are not supposed to be trading on
this group, but it is only an additional aimed at the person writing
post)

Ones that I have, in addition to the ones you listed...

Bastard Sword: One version has 2 spaces between "1994" and "Rob" in the
artist credit, the other has only a single space.

Form of Mist: One version has an extra space between "of" and "Mist" in the
title

J.S. Simmons, Esq: One version has a space between "J. S." in title, one
doesn't

Submachine Gun: One version has 2 spaces between "1994" and "Douglas" in the
artist credit, the other has only a single space.

Man Stopper Rounds: One version has extra ' marks (2 total) on the artist
name (Ne''Ne'' Thomas) instead of Ne'Ne' Thomas.

Aura Reading: Different margins.

Mr Winthrop: Differnt font sizes.

The others probably have similar font/margin differences if any. Those
types of mistakes are very hard to detect and tiny. Especially since you
might not have both, so you will go blind trying to find the differences!
--
Aaron
The Nosferatu Stuff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Here's another list (again compiled by a fan and not guaranteed):

From: mar...@elmo.zso.dec.com (shawn marier)
Newsgroups: alt.games.jyhad,rec.games.deckmaster
Subject: JYHAD : Checklist V4.1
Date: 12 Sep 1994 15:43:25 GMT
Message-ID: <351sut$d...@usenet.pa.dec.com>

Jyhad check list - Rev 4.1 September 12, 1994
-------------------------------------------------
Author Shawn Marier (mar...@zso.dec.com)

Disputed Territory: Typo - The political icon was not printed.
Cat Burglary : Typo - Superior option is not in bold print, this is
ok as both regular and superior effects are the
same due to the rules.
Eco Terrorists : Typo - The cards says "add1" instead of "add 1"
Fists of Death : Typo - The number is off center of the blood drop.
Golconda : Typo - Artist is Kaja Foglio, not Kaja Folio.
Venture Justicar : Typo - The title is incorrect, it should be Ventrue
Justicar. Also the card descriptions has typos,
wherever it refers to Tremere substitute Ventrue.
Zip Gun card : Typo - Artist is Kaja Foglio, not Kaja Fogllo.
The 4th Tradition : This is a minion card, it is printed with the master
(gray) background.
The Spawning Pool : This is a master card, it is printed with the minon
(red) background.

Aura Reading : 2 version exist, you can tell by text spacing.
Bastard Sword : 2 version exist, you can tell by the illustrator spacing.
Business Pressure : 2 version exist, 1 card has "Only usable during a political
action", the other is missing this line.

Chainsaw : 2 version exist, you can tell by the illustrator spacing.
Hell Hound : 2 version exist, you can tell by the print size.
Infernal Pursuit : 2 version exist, one has semi-colon were the other has a
period.
IR Goggles : 2 version exist, you can tell by the text spacing.
J.S. Simmons Esq. : 2 version exist, "J.S." vs "J. S." in the title.
Manstopper Rounds : 2 version exist, Ne Ne vs Ne Ne' on illusrator line.
Night Moves : 2 version exist, you can tell by the text placement, one
is higher.
Physchic Projection : This is the same card as Psychic Projection, the title
of the card was misprinted.
Rampage : 2 version exist, you can tell by the line spacing.
Renegade Garou : 2 version exist, the gangrel icon placement is different.
Submachine Gun : 2 version exist, you can tell by the illustrator spacing.
Tasha Morgan : 2 version exist, each has a different artist listed, and
one has an "All Kindred" restriction.
The 1st Tradition : 2 version exist, You can tell by the statement worth
1 vote is replaced by counts as 1 vote.
Zip Gun : 2 version exist, "Weapon, Gun" is bold and the artists name
is spelled wrong (see above), the version is not bold and
her name is spelled correctly.

--
